stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some older farmers needed help using it.”?
options: A senior nurse said, "Technology is important, but basic skills must remain."
A local school organized student volunteers to teach basic app skills.
The guide realized the app gave basic information, while human guides gave conversation, humor, and local memory.
The school replaced plastic student cards with digital IDs on phones.
